persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make this a classic meme. Top: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY. Bottom: BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY. Big white letters with black outlines, keep it square and don't cover the cat's eyes. No full stops in the actual text.
bank.Typography and punctuation: Classic meme styling: big uppercase white letters with black outlines. Keep the apostrophes, omit full stops.
bank.Picture and framing: Use cat-surprised.jpg, square, with the cat's eyes unobstructed.

messages.text: Can you turn this surprised cat pic into a classic meme? I’ve been having one of those weeks where I keep losing track of what day it is. For the top text, use WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY, and keep the image square. The bottom text should be BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY. Make the lettering big, uppercase, and white with black outlines, and don’t let it cover the cat’s eyes. Keep the apostrophes but leave out full stops in the actual meme text; the free-tier image size is fine.
